department: School of Electrical Engineering and Telecommunications

deadline.value: Engineering points to its term-based closing dates rather than a single date; the international round for Term 2 or 3 2027 closed on 14 August 2026.
deadline.quote: See the deadlines for submission of applications for the next term

entry_route.value: Admission needs a UNSW bachelor's with upper second-class honours or a UNSW Masters by Research, or an equivalent the faculty accepts.
entry_route.quote: an appropriate UNSW Bachelor degree with upper second class Honours

also.quote: a completed Masters by Research from UNSW with a substantial research component

supervisor.value: You must find a supervisor and have their agreement to supervise you before you apply.
supervisor.quote: proof of your supervisor’s agreement to supervise you

also.quote: Identify a potential supervisor and contact them by email

funding.value: Stipends are applied for through UNSW scholarship rounds with their own closing dates, so funding is not promised.
funding.quote: Applicants who are applying for a scholarship stipend through UNSW must submit their application

toefl_min.value: Engineering research degrees need TOEFL iBT 90 overall, with at least 23 in writing and 22 in the other sections.
toefl_min.quote: 90 overall (min. 23 in writing, 22 in reading, listening and speaking)

ielts_min.value: Engineering research degrees need IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, with at least 6.0 in each band.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned for engineering on the pages checked.

notes: Engineering PhD is offered across all UNSW Engineering schools, so this record uses the faculty rules.
